name: Kimi ga Miseta Egao - The Love Illusion in Summer -
original_name: 君が見せた笑顔 - The love illusion in summer -
source:
Main character has good performance at school, but he is not happy about his low points. With his two friends he forms and "Allied Group" with only one aim - to change themselves. One summer day he meets a girl, and this encounter becomes a fated one.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学校表现不错，但他对自己的低分并不满意。他和两个朋友组建了一个“同盟小组”，只有一个目标——改变自己。一个夏日，他遇到了一个女孩，这次相遇成为了命运的邂逅。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
